entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: An optional information element that may be included by the network when certain conditions are met.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: An information element that must be present for the re-attempt indicator to be included.

entities.name: 5GSM cause exclusion condition
entities.description: Condition that the 5GSM cause value is not one of the specified values (#26, #28, #39, #46, #54, #67, #68, #69) for the re-attempt indicator to be included.

relations.description: The re-attempt indicator IE may only be included if the back-off timer value IE is present.
The re-attempt indicator IE may only be included if the 5GSM cause value is not one of the excluded values.
